newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan arrests senior official close to Bhutto.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan arrests senior official close to Bhutto.

text.p: Pakistani police on Tuesday arrested a senior bureaucrat, who had been close to former prime minister Benazir Bhutto, accusing him of corruption and abuse of official position, the state media reported.

Former commerce ministry secretary Salman Farooqi was arrested by the Federal Investigation Agency (FIA) police in Islamabad after an inquiry by investigators from Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif's sectariat, state television said.
The official APP news agency quoted sources in the prime minister's office as saying the arrest was made on Sharif's orders.
